$schema.description: Ignored; lets an editor find the theme file's JSON Schema.

extends.description: Another theme this one starts from (the built-in "default" at the root).

surface_contrast.description: Scales every derived surface's lightness step from the background, within the 40 per cent cap: 1 is the default step, and 1.2 makes cards stronger.

text.description: body text of conversation rows and the composer

muted.description: secondary text: turn-end markers, cwd, metadata

accent.description: prompt marker, focus and the other accents

user.description: the user card's bar; under the flat style also the conversation cursor's inverse block on a user message (defaults to accent's colour)

agent.description: the agent message's gutter glyph, blank unless glyphs.overrides sets gutter.agent; under the flat style, the conversation cursor's inverse gutter on an agent message

permission.description: permission prompt frame and marker glyph

busy.description: the busy indicator's segment in the prompt box's top border under `busy.style` `colour` (bold bright blue by default, bold magenta on a light background, apart from the focused frame's accent)

tool.ok.description: tool line: the ok status glyph

tool.fail.description: tool line: the fail status glyph and word

tool.running.description: tool line: the running status; in-progress tools in the activity region

tool.kind.description: tool line: the kind glyph and kind word (each tool.kind.<kind> defaults to it)

tool.title.description: tool line title, and an expanded tool card's full title

tool.count.description: tool line: line and match counts

tool.result.label.description: a command result's labels in an expanded tool card: `Output:` and `Return code:` (defaults to muted)

tool.kind.read.description: tool line kind of read calls (defaults to tool.kind)

tool.kind.edit.description: tool line kind of edit calls (defaults to tool.kind)

tool.kind.delete.description: tool line kind of delete calls (defaults to tool.kind)

tool.kind.move.description: tool line kind of move calls (defaults to tool.kind)

tool.kind.search.description: tool line kind of search calls (defaults to tool.kind)

tool.kind.execute.description: tool line kind of execute calls (defaults to tool.kind)

tool.kind.think.description: tool line kind of think calls (defaults to tool.kind)

tool.kind.fetch.description: tool line kind of fetch calls (defaults to tool.kind)

tool.kind.switch_mode.description: tool line kind of switch_mode calls (defaults to tool.kind)

tool.kind.other.description: tool line kind of other and unknown calls (defaults to tool.kind)

markdown.heading.1.description: Markdown level 1 headings (the renderer draws the heavy rule)

markdown.heading.2.description: Markdown level 2 headings (the renderer draws the light rule)

markdown.code.description: Markdown inline code, and maths shown as its source

markdown.quote.description: Markdown block quotes and thematic breaks

markdown.table.border.description: Markdown table borders and the record layout's rules

markdown.table.header.description: Markdown table header cells and record headers

markdown.strike.description: Markdown ~~strikethrough~~ (always; SGR 9 only where the terminal draws it)

markdown.alert.note.description: GitHub alert [!NOTE]: bar and header word

markdown.alert.tip.description: GitHub alert [!TIP]: bar and header word

markdown.alert.important.description: GitHub alert [!IMPORTANT]: bar and header word

markdown.alert.warning.description: GitHub alert [!WARNING]: bar and header word

markdown.alert.caution.description: GitHub alert [!CAUTION]: bar and header word

code.default.description: highlighted code: every other scope, and code without a grammar

surface.card.description: expanded tool, thought and plan cards

surface.code.description: code blocks: a neutral fill, never the permission card's hue

surface.overlay.description: overlays: the session list, the link chooser and the @ file picker (the palette, pickers and key help are on the default background); derived at surface.card's step

surface.cursor.description: the conversation cursor's gutter bar (its colour), and the highlighted row of an overlay list (a fill)

surface.cursor.faint.description: the faint fill across the item under the conversation cursor, beside its bar

surface.selection.description: the conversation's text selection (distinct from the cursor's fill)

surface.permission.selected.description: selected option on the permission card (and other cards filled with surface.permission)

find.current.description: the current find hit (text in the default foreground)

find.other.description: the other visible find hits (text in the default foreground)

scrollbar.track.description: the conversation scroll bar's track; flat: the glyph set's `scrollbar.track` in muted

scrollbar.thumb.description: the conversation scroll bar's thumb; flat: the glyph set's `scrollbar.thumb` in muted

tokens.description: Token values by token name (the catalogue of spec tui-theme "Theme tokens, never literal colours").

light.description: Tokens applied over `tokens` when the terminal reports a light background.

anyOf.description: An ANSI palette index from 0 to 255, "default" (the terminal's own background), "derived" (from the terminal's colours) or a "#rrggbb" colour.

color.description: The token's colour; omitted keeps the colour it would otherwise have.

anyOf.description: A colour with the safe text attributes bold, dim, italic and underline.

surfaceTokenValue.description: A colour (or "derived"), or a colour with text attributes.
